Court Acquits Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh in Wrestlers' Harassment Case

A Delhi court acquitted former MP Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh in a case involving allegations of sexual harassment by female wrestlers. The court cited a lack of evidence for its decision. The case stemmed from protests by wrestlers against Singh. Following the acquittal, Singh expressed his relief, stating he had previously said he would hang if proven guilty.
